primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

review.identityCheckJa: 2:1の家系名簿のレビを個人として扱う。6:38、43、47では子孫の系譜内に族祖として明示される。レビ人・レビ族を指す文脈は別案に分ける。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 常時表示欄は書内初出で確認できる範囲に限り、後の関係や出来事は支持節をknownByとする事実へ分けた。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 記事本文の導入はレビをヤコブとレアの子、レビ族の祖として特定する。初出欄は2:1の系譜名に限定し、後続する集団用法を個人説明に混ぜない。

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: レビ族／レビ人を指す複数節は族祖個人とは対象が異なる。集団文脈案は未統合。
